member.name: OrdinalBase
member.para: The transcripts these three spellings come from. On "De vandrande djäknarne" (LibriVox, ggml-small, 2026-08-14) Whisper wrote "Älfte kapitlet" at 3:10:09 and "tolvte och sista kapitlet" at 4:31:22, and both announcements were logged as "no readable number" - the second cost the book its last chapter outright.
